description: Run a reproducible smoke-test-first LoRA training cycle and generate its downstream verification input.
name: finetune_configurable_training_cycle
template:
Complete configurable training input. When a workflow is selected, copy every line between `<workflow_input>` and `</workflow_input>` unchanged into `run_workflow.user_prompt`; do not shorten it to a workflow or skill name and do not omit any field.

<workflow_input>
Project root: `{{project_root}}`
Training configuration (absolute): `{{training_config}}`
Training objective file: {{training_objective_file}}
Inline training objective: {{training_goal}}

Load and validate the selected objective file before using `rag_query`.

User-provided subject context (runtime data):
{{domain_context}}

Treat supplied context as authoritative and keep named products, terminology and facts out of reusable source code and configuration. Produce a source-to-subject contract with a runtime-derived contentScope and deterministic contentRules for clearly delimited out-of-scope sections in mixed sources. Store domain-specific rules only in the generated run policy. Then require deterministic content filtering, hash deduplication, source and subject balancing, non-overlapping held-out coverage and a smoke gate. Python applies the fixed metric, patience and best-checkpoint policy and generates data/verifications/<run>/verification_input.json after successful full training. Merge, verification and installation remain explicit later operations.

Return the objective source, source assignments, policy report, dataset counts, smoke result, full-training result, early-stop state, best checkpoint, artifact path, verificationInputPath and unresolved risks.
</workflow_input>
